notes.title: Demo Update – New Level + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We’ve rolled out a new update for the demo! This patch tackles a number of bugs and also introduces a brand-new fast-paced level. It’s completely optional, but we hope you’ll give it a try and have fun with it.
Highlights of this update:
New Level: Intro City → Grass – a fast-paced experience added to the demo.

UI Improvements: Adjusted interface on entry for a smoother start.

Better Transitions: Cleaner fade-ins and improved loading flow.

Silver Nuggets: Now rewarded when re-doing an already completed cave puzzle.

Rail System Update: Adjustments made, though speed is still tied to FPS. If rails feel too fast, set your FPS to Max 60 in the settings menu and back out to apply.

Virtual Cameras: Now highlight which areas you’re moving into.

And More: Several smaller improvements under the hood, with plenty more on the way!

Thanks for checking out the demo and sharing your feedback—it really helps shape the game as we continue development!
